sub_sector.value: Turf equipment; underground construction equipment; snow equipment

manufacturing_type.detail: Builds individual units such as turf mowers, snowplows, and underground construction equipment.

production_model.detail: Offers named product models through distributors, dealers, rental stores, and retailers.

product_complexity.detail: Autonomous mowers integrate property mapping, repeatable mowing patterns, and safety systems.

production_role.detail: Sells branded turf, landscape, snow and ice, underground and specialty construction, irrigation, and outdoor lighting products.

end_market_exposure.detail: Serves golf courses, landscape professionals, sports venues, public institutions, underground and specialty contractors, rental companies, homeowners, and agricultural growers.

notes: Make-to-stock is inferred from named product models and distribution through dealers and retailers.
